description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting Standard Changes with effect from 01.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of Sri Lanka Accounting Standards by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for financial reporting, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel changes.
